Description.body: The required -ids parameter accepts comma-separated document or chunk IDs and terminated inclusive ranges, for example 1-5,7,16-22. Open-ended ranges are unsupported. Selections pass unchanged to the configured backend, which expands and deduplicates them in request order. Deleting a document also deletes its chunks. Valid IDs are deleted even if other requested IDs are absent. Returns aggregate deleted from DB and deleted from storage counters and a not_found array. Missing IDs do not fail the request: error_code is 0 unless deletion fails.
